# Servy

> Servy is a free, open-source Windows service wrapper. It runs any executable or script as a native Windows service and manages its lifecycle, including startup, shutdown, crash recovery, logging, and health monitoring. It can be managed through a desktop app, a command-line interface, or a PowerShell module.

Servy is an alternative to tools such as NSSM and WinSW. It is licensed under the MIT license and is available through WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop, Patch My PC, and GitHub Releases.

Key capabilities:

- Run any application as a native Windows service
- Auto-recovery after crashes, hangs, and failures
- Per-service security isolation, with support for gMSA, Active Directory, and Local System accounts
- Pre-launch, post-launch, pre-stop, and post-stop hooks
- Real-time CPU and RAM monitoring, with stdout and stderr streaming
- Health checks, notifications, and heartbeat pings
- Log rotation and configurable process priority, working directory, and environment variables
